title: 深不可测的男人
slug: 豪门情变前夫过期不候全本免费-豪门情变前夫过期不候最新章节列表
content_zh:
心语拉起被子盖住满身的狼狈，泪无声落在蚕丝被上氲染开来，“为什么要这样对我？”
他居高临下，习惯性抽出烟，点燃，烟雾升腾，隐匿了他的表情，烟雾缭绕的背后，只看见一张俊美非常的脸透着丝丝青白之色，这般森冷，让人觉得诡异非常。
“为什么？有一天……你会知道的！”绝然转身，临到门边。
“我要离婚。”她的声音在颤抖，心像被针尖划过一般疼。顾天承笑话一样，“你随时都可以走，只要……你走得掉！”心语咬牙套上衣服，心里只有一个念头，她要走，要离开他，她对他的爱有多深，他给她的伤害就有多深，这种落差，足以毁了她整个人生！一口气跑出房间，跑出别墅。
昏黄的路灯下漫起一团团白雾，心语只是拼命往前跑，分不清方向，不知道要去哪里。她心里很清楚，她不可能跟他离婚，颜家沉疴已久，迫切的需要攀上顾家这个‘高枝’，而她是颜家唯一可以拿得出手的‘筹码’！她没猜到他们会这样开始，却已经猜到了结局。
十六岁到二十三岁，她爱了他整整八年，她从来都不知道，爱一个人会这么痛苦，明知会粉身碎骨，却无法阻止自己靠近……
“叱……”刺耳的急刹车声，心语吓得跌落在地。
男人微探出头，心语对上一双好看的眼睛，褐色瞳仁，像是镀上了层水膜般，三分潋滟，七分凉薄，精致的眉眼和顾少卿有八分相像，顾少卿的俊美中透着几分妖凉，眼前这个男人却是沉稳内敛的低调奢华，隔着这么远的距离都能感觉到他身上散发厚重的压迫感。
男人微微蹙眉，柔弱的身形触及眼底，似曾相识，信步踱到她身前，倾身蹲下，一手勾起心语的下巴，“是你？”
心语是真的吓到了，忘了反应，傻傻望着他，“你……？”
“顾天承…你和少卿的婚礼我们见过。”淡淡的语气，手还勾着她，丝毫没有要扶她的意思。
心语愕然，顾天承，少卿同父异母的大哥！她记起来了，婚礼上确实有一面之缘，他不是一直在国外吗，怎么会在这里，还遇到这么狼狈的她！
男人自顾起身，没有扶她，“上车，我送你回去。”强硬的语气，少了些人情味。
心语蹙眉，这个男人…太深，深不见底的深！

content_en:
Xinyu pulled up the quilt to cover her embarrassment, her tears fell silently on the silk quilt and stained it, "Why are you doing this to me?"
He was condescending and habitually took out his cigarette and lit it. The smoke rose, hiding his expression. Behind the smoke, he could only see a very handsome face with a hint of green and white color. It was so cold and strange, which made people feel very strange.
"Why? One day... you will know!" Juoran turned around and came to the door.
"I want a divorce." Her voice was trembling, and her heart hurt as if it had been scratched by a needle. Gu Tiancheng joked, "You can leave at any time, as long as... you can leave!" He ran out of the room and out of the villa in one breath.
Under the dim street lights, clouds of white mist were rising, and Xinyu just ran forward with all her strength, unable to tell the direction and not knowing where she was going. She knew very well that there was no way she could divorce him. The Yan family had been suffering from illness for a long time, and they urgently needed to climb onto the "high branch" of the Gu family, and she was the only "chip" the Yan family could use! She didn't expect them to start like this, but she had already guessed the ending.
From the age of sixteen to twenty-three, she loved him for eight years. She never knew that loving someone would be so painful. She knew that she would be broken into pieces, but she couldn't stop herself from getting closer...
"Shout..." There was a harsh sudden braking sound, and Xinyu fell to the ground in fright.
The man tilted his head slightly and met a pair of beautiful eyes. The brown pupils seemed to be coated with a layer of water. They were three-quarters sparkling and seven-quarters cold. His delicate eyebrows were eighty-quarters like Gu Shaoqing's. Gu Shaoqing's handsomeness had a bit of enchantment, but the man in front of him was calm, restrained, low-key and luxurious. From such a long distance, you could feel the heavy oppression emanating from him.
The man frowned slightly, his weak figure touching the bottom of his eyes, as if he had seen her before. He strolled in front of her, leaned down and squatted down, lifting Xinyu's chin with one hand, "Is that you?"
Xinyu was really frightened. She forgot to react and looked at him stupidly, "You...?"
"Gu Tiancheng...we have seen your wedding with Shaoqing." His tone was calm, and his hand was still hooked on her, with no intention of helping her.
Xinyu was shocked, Gu Tiancheng, Shaoqing’s half-brother! She remembered that there was indeed a chance encounter at the wedding. Hadn't he been abroad all the time? How could he be here and meet her in such an embarrassing state?
The man stood up without helping her, "Get in the car, I'll take you back." His tough tone was less humane.
Xinyu frowned, this man... is too deep, bottomless deep!
